sourcePosition: 原作者2019论文Method / Measures / Emotion Regulation Strategies，按四类策略逐项完整列出19题；补充文件仅为领导情境与评分示例，不是另一个题本

questions.authorEnglish: When I want to feel more positive emotion, I can change aspects of the situation in order to do that,
questions.platformChinese: 当我想体验更多积极情绪时，我能改变情境中的某些方面来做到这一点。

questions.authorEnglish: I can change the emotional nature of a situation by injecting humor into the situation,
questions.platformChinese: 我能通过在情境中加入幽默，改变它带来的情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I manage my emotions by changing aspects of the situation
questions.platformChinese: 我会通过改变情境中的某些方面来调节自己的情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I am able to distract myself from strong emotions,
questions.platformChinese: 我能够把注意力从强烈的情绪上转移开。

questions.authorEnglish: When I am in an emotional situation, I manage my emotions by focusing on non-emotional aspects of the situation,
questions.platformChinese: 处在带有情绪的情境中时，我会把注意力放在其中不涉及情绪的方面，来调节自己的情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: It is hard for me to stop thinking about the emotions I am feelings
questions.platformChinese: 我很难停止想着自己正在感受到的情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: When experiencing negative emotions, I am unable to think about anything but that emotion
questions.platformChinese: 体验消极情绪时，除了那种情绪，我无法想到别的事情。

questions.authorEnglish: When I want to feel more positive emotions, I can change my perspective on the situation,
questions.platformChinese: 当我想体验更多积极情绪时，我能换个角度看待情境。

questions.authorEnglish: When I want to feel less negative emotions, I can change my perspective on the situation,
questions.platformChinese: 当我想少体验一些消极情绪时，我能换个角度看待情境。

questions.authorEnglish: I can control my negative emotions by changing the way I think about the situation,
questions.platformChinese: 我能通过改变对情境的看法来控制自己的消极情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I can control my positive emotions by changing the way I think about the situation,
questions.platformChinese: 我能通过改变对情境的看法来控制自己的积极情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I manage my emotions by changing my perspective on the situation I am in,
questions.platformChinese: 我会通过改变看待所处情境的角度来调节自己的情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I can increase my feelings of positive emotions by thinking about different aspects of the situation,
questions.platformChinese: 我能通过思考情境中的不同方面，增加自己的积极情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I can decrease my feelings of negative emotions by thinking about different aspects of the situation
questions.platformChinese: 我能通过思考情境中的不同方面，减少自己的消极情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I generally try not to show my negative emotions,
questions.platformChinese: 我通常会尽量不表现出自己的消极情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I keep my emotions to myself,
questions.platformChinese: 我把自己的情绪留在心里。

questions.authorEnglish: I manage my emotions by not expressing them,
questions.platformChinese: 我会通过不表达情绪来调节自己的情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I do not express my negative emotions,
questions.platformChinese: 我不表达自己的消极情绪。

questions.authorEnglish: I generally try not to show my positive emotions
questions.platformChinese: 我通常会尽量不表现出自己的积极情绪。
